b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader. It fetches a URL (with up to 3 retries and a 20 s timeout) and writes the bytes to a file or to stdout.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [options]
```

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |
'
